_comment: Cash in the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund. MoF / PMDRF, 23 Bhadra 17:00 — nine-bank NPR stock Rs 8,766,900,000 (published to the lakh). Post-flood collections Rs 7,684,400,000 plus pre-flood Rs 2,082,400,000 equal Rs 9,766,800,000 before the Rs 1,000,000,000 already released (9,766,800,000 − 1,000,000,000 = 8,766,800,000; the stock closes at 8,766,900,000 with a Rs 100,000 round-to-lakh difference). No new nine-bank row table was published with this update — the panel carries the MoF stock total. USD 21,108,471 (~Rs 3.18 billion at 150.88); total-available label Rs 11,951,700,000. Two rules: (1) the pre-disaster balance is already inside the 8.77 billion — never add it again; (2) name-transfer, NCHL, PhonePe, foreign pledges, in-kind and IFRC are not this bank stock. app/domains/flood/content.py re-adds breakdown rows at load.

breakdowns.caption_en: Nine-bank NPR stock Rs 8.77 billion (MoF, published to the lakh). Published post-flood collections Rs 7,684,400,000 plus pre-flood Rs 2,082,400,000 before the Rs 1 billion release; the net post-flood figure that closes with this stock is Rs 6,684,500,000. No fresh bank-by-bank table was published with this update. USD is a separate label; total-available label Rs 11.95 billion.
breakdowns.caption_ne: नौ-बैंक NPR मौज्दात रु. ८ अर्ब ७६ करोड ६९ लाख (अर्थ, लाखसम्म)। विपद्पछि सकल रु. 7,684,400,000 + मौज्दात रु. 2,082,400,000, १ अर्ब निकासापछि नेट रु. 6,684,500,000। यो अपडेटसँग नयाँ बैंकतालिका आएको छैन। डलर छुट्टै; कुल उपलब्ध लेबल रु. ११ अर्ब ९५ करोड १७ लाख।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The Rs 2.08 billion already in the fund is inside the 8.77 billion, not on top of it. USD 21.11 million is not part of the Nepali-rupee total; the 'total available' label Rs 11,951,700,000 is NPR stock plus USD equivalent — not a second cash pile. Name-transfer, NCHL, PhonePe, foreign pledges, World Bank and IFRC are not this bank stock.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: विपद्अघिको मौज्दात ८.७७ अर्बभित्र छ, माथि होइन। डलर नेपाली जम्मामा होइन। नाम-हस्तान्तरण, NCHL, फोनपे, वैदेशिक घोषणा, विश्व बैंक र आईएफआरसी यो बैंक मौज्दात होइनन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: UK $6.79m + US $3.6m + OCHA $3.2m + South Korea $1m + ADB $5m + UAE $10m + Jensen Huang $10m. These are pledges and contributions announced outside the published rupee balance, not cash counted in the Prime Minister's fund table.
breakdowns.caption_ne: बेलायत $६.७९ मि. + अमेरिका $३.६ मि. + ओसीएचए $३.२ मि. + दक्षिण कोरिया $१ मि. + एडीबी $५ मि. + युएई $१० मि. + जेन्सेन ह्वाङ $१० मि.। यी प्रकाशित रुपैयाँ मौज्दातबाहिरका घोषणा/योगदान हुन्, कोषको तालिकामा गनिएको नगद होइनन्।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: Not added to the Rs 8.77 billion. World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC CHF 25 million appeal are separate lines, not inside this $39.59 million. ADB $5m and UAE $10m are pledges, not cash received. UAE's 83-tonne flight is inside the $10m package, not on top of it. Jensen Huang's $10m (about Rs 1.51 billion) is a contribution to the Prime Minister's fund that the published rupee balance does not yet carry — count it once, here.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: रु. ८ अर्ब ७६ करोडमा जोडिँदैन। विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी CHF २५ मिलियन अपिल यो $३९.५९ मिलियनभित्र होइनन्। एडीबी $५ मिलियन र युएई $१० मिलियन घोषणा हुन्, आएको नगद होइनन्। युएईको ८३ टन उडान $१० मिलियनभित्र छ, माथि होइन। जेन्सेन ह्वाङको $१० मिलियन (करिब रु. १.५१ अर्ब) प्रधानमन्त्री कोषमा गएको योगदान हो जुन प्रकाशित रुपैयाँ मौज्दातले अझै समेटेको छैन — एक पटक, यहीँ गन्नुहोस्।
